# Norvig English frequency list

`norvig_count_1w.txt` is the `count_1w.txt` word-frequency list published by
Peter Norvig at <https://www.norvig.com/ngrams/count_1w.txt>.

It contains 333,333 lowercase English word forms and their counts, derived from
the Google Web Trillion Word Corpus. LinguaFlow uses it only to extend offline
English autocomplete when an existing bilingual lexicon entry is unavailable;
existing Chinese glosses always take precedence.
